_README.built: 2026-10-09 against production (read-only GET probes via scripts/eval-probe.mjs)
_README.format: fixtures[]: id, category, query (owner-voice question), relevantIds (1-5 live memory UUIDs that truly answer it; empty for abstention), mustNotIds (stale/superseded-in-meaning memories that should NOT outrank the answer; optional), notes.
_README.categories: single_fact (10), knowledge_update (8, latest state wins), temporal (8), multi_session (6), entity (4), abstention (4, nothing in memory answers it)
_README.verify: node scripts/eval-probe.mjs verify — fetches every relevantId/mustNotId and flags missing/archived/superseded rows
_README.maintenance: Memories are rewritten/archived over time. Re-run verify before trusting a score; replace dead ids rather than deleting the question.
